metrics_finding.finding: CPU utilization and mean latency have increased for the auth-service during the failure window.

evidence_summary.summary: CPU utilization and mean latency have increased for the auth-service during the failure window.

report.suggested_fix: Monitor CPU utilization and mean latency for the auth-service to ensure they are within normal ranges.

report_text.en: The root cause of the incident is believed to be related to increased CPU utilization and mean latency for the auth-service. Monitoring these metrics will help prevent similar incidents in the future.
report_text.hi: अप्रत्याशित घटना के मुख्य कारण विश्वसनीयता स्तर 0.8 है। प्रवर्तन की सलाह: अथेंटिसेवी की CPU उपयोगिता और औसत लेटेंसी को नियमित रूप से जांचें।
